01a19af66815.en: Eori felt the hardness of the bony plate. Feels the same as when I did it on myself. Opening his mouth with her hand, she saw the bony plate open up, revealing a row of gills flushing with a mixture of venous and arterial blood—more of the venous side of things, though. She moved her head closer to the gills while moving Harry’s mouth towards the fost stone lamp. 01a19af66815.t: Eori merasa kekerasan kepingan bertulang itu. Rasa sama macam masa aku buat kat diri sendiri. Membuka mulutnya dengan tangan, dia melihat kepingan bertulang itu terbuka, mendedahkan sebaris insang yang dibasahi campuran darah vena dan arteri—lebih kepada darah vena, walau bagaimanapun. Dia mendekatkan kepalanya ke insang itu sambil menggerakkan mulut Harry ke arah lampu fost stone. Ini membolehkannya melihat cahaya putih memasuki mulutnya dan menerangi sepanjang jalan ke dalam trakeanya dan keluar melalui insang. Memang nampak macam yang aku jangka.

055810b2c8e6.en: Eori looked at Harry with a vicious smile forming in her mouth. She couldn’t contain a tickling sensation rushing through her body. “Let’s celebrate!” She turned her back to him, and with a leg high up above the table, she climbed on it with a jump and squatted over him, akin to a hucklebuck position.
055810b2c8e6.t: Eori memandang Harry dengan senyuman ganas terbentuk di mulutnya. Dia tidak dapat menahan sensasi geletek yang mengalir di seluruh badannya. “Jom raikan!” Dia membelakangkan Harry, dan dengan sebelah kaki diangkat tinggi di atas meja, dia memanjatnya dengan lompatan dan mencangkung di atasnya, seperti posisi hucklebuck.

072face50188.en: Eori let out a large moan, freezing her hip swinging midway as Harry played with her slit like he was doing a harmonica solo. “Aw! Like that! Yes!” She panted while she bit her plump lips, feeling an intense relief permeating through her body. After the feeling started to subside, her eyes then mesmerized at how intensely his right-slanted worm throbbed, and his entire body jolted uncontrollably. Is this involuntary movement? She peeked inside his boxers, seeing his worm surrounded by a pool of white stuff as its throbbing pace began to settle down. Is that a lot? She took her hand out of his boxers and whipped it away in Harry’s slimy belly. “Harry?” She shifted her body forward, seeking an answer as he now seemed only to be spasming around rather than the wild reaction from before. That was far more intense than last time.
072face50188.t: Eori mengeluarkan rintihan besar, membekukan hayunan pinggulnya separuh jalan sementara Harry bermain dengan alurnya seperti dia sedang bermain solo harmonika. “Aw! Macam tu! Ya!” Dia tercungap sambil menggigit bibirnya yang montok, merasa kelegaan yang amat sangat meresap ke seluruh badannya. Selepas perasaan itu mula reda, matanya kemudian terpesona melihat betapa kuatnya cacingnya yang condong ke kanan berdenyut, dan seluruh badannya tersentak tanpa kawalan. Ni pergerakan luar kawal ke? Dia mengintai ke dalam seluar boxernya, melihat cacingnya dikelilingi kolam benda putih sementara rentak denyutannya mula reda. Tu banyak ke? Dia mengeluarkan tangannya dari seluar boxer Harry dan mengesatnya pada perut Harry yang berlendir. “Harry?” Dia mengalihkan badannya ke hadapan, mencari jawapan kerana Harry kini kelihatan hanya kejang-kejang dan bukannya reaksi liar seperti tadi. Tu jauh lebih kuat daripada kali lepas.

07395063a1ee.en: “Princess E-Eori?” Harry asked with a soft tone in his voice, holding a grounded nari stone in his palm. It had a bluish hue that glimmered magically—it looked like a ground-up version of a mana potion, at least for someone who didn’t know the scientific background and properties of nari.
07395063a1ee.t: “Puteri E-Eori?” Harry bertanya dengan nada lembut dalam suaranya, memegang batu nari yang sudah dikisar di tapak tangannya. Ia mempunyai rona kebiruan yang berkilauan secara ajaib—ia kelihatan seperti versi kisar ramuan mana, sekurang-kurangnya bagi seseorang yang tidak tahu latar belakang saintifik dan sifat-sifat nari.

08f91b10e4b2.en: “Raise your right hand!” Eori continued to observe his spasms. His right hand jerked once, then went limp. Eori jumped off the table and approached the serving bowl atop the nearby writing desk, now tantalizing her to indulge on it too. It can’t be that sensitive! He has to be full of shit! She picked a spoonful, took out the lakata pieces with her hand, then gulped it down like nothing—not even the rubbery texture or excessive earthy taste mixed with the blood of this experimental nari gel bothered her palate that much. “Fucking breathe!” She stood by Harry and slapped his slimy chest, all while her skin transformed. The transformation’s pain and itchy feeling were there, making her clench her face, but her mind was more focused on analyzing how sensitive she was becoming. She could feel her heartbeat pulsating in her privates, almost making her body reach new heights of euphoria from just that feeling alone.
08f91b10e4b2.t: “Angkat tangan kanan kau!” Eori terus memerhatikan kejangnya. Tangan kanannya tersentak sekali, kemudian menjadi lembik. Eori melompat turun dari meja dan mendekati mangkuk hidangan di atas meja tulis berdekatan, yang kini menggoda untuk dia turut menikmatinya. Takkan la sensitif sangat! Dia mesti mengarut! Dia mengambil sesudu, mengeluarkan kepingan lakata dengan tangannya, kemudian menelannya seperti tiada apa-apa—malah tekstur kenyal atau rasa tanah yang berlebihan bercampur darah nari gel eksperimen ini tidak begitu mengganggu seleranya. “Bernafas la sial!” Dia berdiri di sebelah Harry dan menampar dadanya yang berlendir, sementara kulitnya sendiri berubah. Kesakitan dan rasa gatal transformasi itu ada, membuatkan dia mengerutkan mukanya, tetapi fikirannya lebih tertumpu pada menganalisis betapa sensitif dirinya menjadi. Dia dapat merasa denyutan jantungnya berdenyut di kemaluannya, hampir membuatkan badannya mencapai tahap euforia baru hanya dari perasaan itu sahaja.

09b95306b50b.en: Eiri had a mischievous, vicious smile looking at his erect worm imprinting itself on Harry’s whitish boxers. She couldn’t stop grinning from ear to ear, so much so that her cheeks were nearly hurting. She bit her lips, holding back the excitement enveloping her body of truly stepping into the forerunning of science. She peeked into his boxers and saw what had to be a petrified worm attached to him, having the same color as the rest of his skin. What made this worm different was that it had a slightly right crook. Is it all skin, then? She then pried his mouth open and noticed the inside of his mouth was also turning the same color and wavy texture. Is it because I am feeding the medallion instead of just worm skin? She rushed another spoon into his mouth, containing another blue-carapace worm medallion. “How about now?”
09b95306b50b.t: Eiri mempunyai senyuman nakal yang ganas memandang cacingnya yang tegang membentuk cetakan pada seluar boxer putih Harry. Dia tidak dapat berhenti tersengih dari telinga ke telinga, sehinggakan pipinya hampir sakit. Dia menggigit bibirnya, menahan keterujaan yang menyelubungi badannya kerana benar-benar melangkah ke barisan hadapan sains. Dia mengintai ke dalam seluar boxernya dan melihat apa yang pasti cacing membatu yang melekat padanya, mempunyai warna yang sama dengan kulitnya yang lain. Apa yang membuatkan cacing ini berbeza ialah ia sedikit bengkok ke kanan. Semuanya kulit ke, kalau macam tu? Dia kemudian mengungkil mulutnya terbuka dan perasan bahagian dalam mulutnya juga bertukar kepada warna dan tekstur beralun yang sama. Sebab aku suap kepingan cacing dan bukan kulit cacing je ke? Dia cepat-cepat menyumbat sesudu lagi ke dalam mulutnya, mengandungi satu lagi kepingan cacing berkarapas biru. “Macam mana sekarang?”

0be81c4a53b9.en: A vivacious smile arose in Eori, feeling a happy tickle inside her innards as her mind couldn’t fathom how this concoction would perform. This is going to be fun! Eori tossed the journal at the table and pointed back at the grinder. “Go finish it! We’re experimenting shortly!” Eori’s hands were nearly moving on their own, grabbing mixing bowls from the walls and other utensils and laying them quickly on the table. There is something different about Harry—the growing list of strange words and the fact I failed to replicate his body hair are clear signs Gabiro did something. A single word loudly came out of her mouth, “FUCK!” She continued grabbing supplies for the experiment. I can’t believe I didn’t cross-check his baseline reaction before! That was fucking stupid of me! She grabbed another bowl. A vicious smile arose from ear to ear, feeling like a shot of pure exploratory energy was being injected into her veins. If he doesn’t perform baseline, then I will have an excuse to shift into completely exploratory research!
0be81c4a53b9.t: Senyuman bersemangat timbul pada Eori, merasakan geli hati yang gembira di dalam perutnya sementara fikirannya tidak dapat membayangkan bagaimana ramuan ini akan berfungsi. Ni mesti seronok! Eori mencampakkan jurnal itu ke atas meja dan menunjuk kembali ke arah pengisar. “Pergi habiskan! Kita akan bereksperimen sekejap lagi!” Tangan Eori hampir bergerak sendiri, mengambil mangkuk adunan dari dinding dan perkakas lain dan meletakkannya dengan cepat di atas meja. Ada sesuatu yang lain pasal Harry—senarai perkataan pelik yang makin panjang dan hakikat aku gagal meniru bulu badan dia ialah tanda jelas Gabiro buat sesuatu. Satu perkataan keluar dengan kuat dari mulutnya, “CELAKA!” Dia terus mengambil bekalan untuk eksperimen itu. Aku tak percaya aku tak semak silang reaksi garis dasar dia sebelum ni! Bodoh sial aku! Dia mengambil satu lagi mangkuk. Senyuman ganas timbul dari telinga ke telinga, merasakan seolah-olah suntikan tenaga penerokaan tulen sedang dimasukkan ke dalam uratnya. Kalau dia tak berprestasi pada garis dasar, maka aku akan ada alasan untuk beralih kepada kajian penerokaan sepenuhnya!

0d9a3e2674bf.en: “Fungus. Best catalyst for lowering heart rate and reducing the urge to breathe,” Eori spoke after like she had memorized those words to heart.
0d9a3e2674bf.t: “Kulat. Pemangkin terbaik untuk menurunkan kadar denyutan jantung dan mengurangkan desakan untuk bernafas,” Eori bercakap kemudian seolah-olah dia telah menghafal kata-kata itu.

0f58c4771e1a.en: “I—not—sure?” Harry spoke through his teeth. After a few seconds, he opened his eyes a bit. He squinted, looking at his own body, then relaxed and wiped the leftover nari gel from his mouth. “It—just—like when you’re sick with the flu?”
0f58c4771e1a.t: “Saya—tak—pasti?” Harry bercakap melalui giginya. Selepas beberapa saat, dia membuka matanya sedikit. Dia mengecilkan mata, memandang badannya sendiri, kemudian bertenang dan mengesat sisa nari gel dari mulutnya. “Ia—cuma—macam bila awak sakit selesema?”

0faf0f56a1b0.en: “Fi-hi—fihi?” Harry’s tone seemed to grow worried as he kept on glancing at Eori’s straight face.
0faf0f56a1b0.t: “Fi-hi—fihi?” Nada Harry kelihatan semakin risau sambil dia terus mengerling wajah Eori yang serius.

113f6dc9b657.t: Menjadi tegang, Harry mengeluarkan satu lagi jeritan nikmat bernada tinggi. “Tak—sekarang—ia cuma—jijik dan basah!” Cacing dalam seluar boxernya semakin membesar, mendirikan khemah dengan sendirinya di tengah-tengah eksperimen saintifik di pinggiran rasa ingin tahu saintifik—dengan sedikit kegatalan sebagai penambah rasa.

15a876ec1735.en: “WHAT?” Eori snapped at Harry. Seeing the pile of ground-up nari offered to her, she walked up close and grabbed a bit with her fingers, rubbing them back and forth, checking the granularity. “Keep going. I need a dust-like appearance for nari gels.” She flicked his ear. “Don’t call me princess, you fuckwad! I’m a scientist.” She cleaned her fingers on his hair, leaving a dusty, shiny look. Princess my Sanbi ass. I never wanted that! She walked back to the morbid selection of gels, shuffling her purple hair out of her face.
15a876ec1735.t: “APA?” Eori menengking Harry. Melihat timbunan nari kisar yang dihulurkan kepadanya, dia berjalan mendekat dan mengambil sedikit dengan jari-jarinya, menggosoknya ke depan dan ke belakang, memeriksa kehalusannya. “Teruskan. Aku perlukan rupa macam habuk untuk nari gel.” Dia menjentik telinga Harry. “Jangan panggil aku puteri, bangsat! Aku saintis.” Dia membersihkan jarinya pada rambut Harry, meninggalkan rupa berhabuk yang berkilat. Puteri kepala bontot Sanbi aku. Aku tak pernah nak semua tu! Dia berjalan kembali ke pilihan gel yang mengerikan itu, menyelak rambut ungunya dari muka.

17aec14081a8.en: Harry came back to life with a groan and heavy twitching as his skin changed back to human, but this time it looked like he was shredded. His dehydrated skin was showing the finer details of all superficial muscles in his body, while the slime that was being spewed by his skin gave him a shiny look—he looked like an oiled strawweight fighter that pushed the boundaries of cutting water weight a bit too much.
17aec14081a8.t: Harry kembali hidup dengan erangan dan kedutan kuat sementara kulitnya berubah kembali kepada manusia, tetapi kali ini dia kelihatan sangat berotot. Kulitnya yang kekeringan menunjukkan perincian halus semua otot cetek di badannya, sementara lendir yang dikeluarkan oleh kulitnya memberinya rupa berkilat—dia kelihatan seperti petarung kelas strawweight yang berminyak yang melampaui batas memotong berat air sedikit terlalu banyak.

18ab95dc8a23.en: Eori touched his chest again, pushing him back to the table. “Lie back down!”
18ab95dc8a23.t: Eori menyentuh dadanya lagi, menolaknya kembali ke meja. “Baring balik!”

1962729c7921.en: “Breathe faster! PANT! YES! Pant!” Eori kept tapping his chest.
1962729c7921.t: “Bernafas lebih laju! TERCUNGAP! YA! Tercungap!” Eori terus menepuk dadanya.

1c809fdcf910.en: Eori nodded with a spoon in hand, picking a worm medallion with a blue carapace. “Exactly. No Breath Tier Two, for most people, means you can temporarily breathe underwater by sucking water through your mouth and pushing it out through your neck gills or by keeping your mouth open as you swim. You would still need to surface now and then to breathe air.” Waving her hands towards Harry’s neck, she continued spilling out things in a factual tone, “The gills are not big enough. If you go Tiers Three and Four, more gills appear on your back, and you can use your diaphragm to move water around, but you can’t breathe air anymore. Felt anything else?”
1c809fdcf910.t: Eori mengangguk dengan sudu di tangan, mengambil kepingan cacing dengan karapas biru. “Tepat sekali. Tanpa Nafas Tahap Dua, bagi kebanyakan orang, bermaksud kau boleh bernafas dalam air buat sementara waktu dengan menyedut air melalui mulut dan menolaknya keluar melalui insang leher atau dengan membiarkan mulut terbuka semasa berenang. Kau masih perlu naik ke permukaan sekali-sekala untuk menghirup udara.” Melambai tangannya ke arah leher Harry, dia terus menghamburkan perkara-perkara dengan nada fakta, “Insang tu tak cukup besar. Kalau kau pergi Tahap Tiga dan Empat, lebih banyak insang muncul kat belakang, dan kau boleh guna diafragma untuk gerakkan air, tapi kau tak boleh hirup udara lagi. Ada rasa apa-apa lagi?”

1e05fcb7f007.en: She took her arm off the floor, looked, and smelled the droplets of a yellowish liquid dripping off her arm. Eww! I pissed myself! She sat on the basement floor, feeling more at home than back at Sanbi Castle. Mother will regret not giving me this earlier on!
1e05fcb7f007.t: Dia mengangkat lengannya dari lantai, melihat, dan menghidu titisan cecair kekuningan yang menitis dari lengannya. Eee! Aku terkencing! 208e8cda2e95.t: “Saya tak rasa desakan untuk bernafas?” Harry menggosok dadanya. “Paru-paru saya rasa normal sekarang, tapi tadi rasa macam—saya terhidu asap? Ia—sakit untuk bernafas.”

27f6fd59bb3a.t: “Saintis Eori, maafkan saya—” Harry mengangkat tangannya yang dirantai separuh ke udara, tidak kelihatan mempertahankan diri, tetapi lebih seperti menyerah.

2d0d7eb1181c.t: Eori menggigit kukunya, kembali memandang jurnalnya. Matanya terus membaca, mencari sesuatu yang menarik, akhirnya menjumpai satu. Memperkenalkan semula atau mengekalkan refleks pernafasan semula jadi tanpa menjejaskan desakan untuk bernafas? Eori memandang dinding mengerikan itu untuk mencari jawapan. Celaka. Aku lupa nak kaji—

2d3d297c7100.en: “Frog? What the fuck?” Eori stared at Harry with perplexed pink irises, then took her journal back swiftly. “Are you that fucking stupid?” Eori tapped the name on the page, nearly shoving the journal in his face. “No Breath means we’re tampering with the lungs! NOT THE SKIN!” Eori raised the journal above her head, gathering strength to strike Harry across the face—with part of her brain delaying the punishment as she felt a good tickle from seeing how growingly domesticated he had become. With her nose high in the air like a snooty celebrity, she said blatantly, “Anything else stupid to say? Huh?”
2d3d297c7100.t: “Katak? Apa benda sial ni?” Eori merenung Harry dengan iris merah jambu yang kebingungan, kemudian merampas jurnalnya kembali dengan pantas. “Kau bodoh sangat ke sial?” Eori mengetuk nama pada muka surat itu, hampir menyumbat jurnal itu ke mukanya. “Tanpa Nafas bermaksud kita usik paru-paru! BUKAN KULIT!” Eori mengangkat jurnal itu ke atas kepalanya, mengumpul tenaga untuk memukul muka Harry—dengan sebahagian otaknya menangguhkan hukuman itu kerana dia merasa geli hati yang menyenangkan melihat betapa jinaknya Harry kian menjadi. Dengan hidungnya tinggi di udara seperti selebriti yang sombong, dia berkata terang-terangan, “Ada apa-apa lagi benda bodoh nak cakap? Hah?”

2e9c76f38906.en: With mischievous laughter, Eori rubbed her finger down Harry’s chest and stomach, picking up slime along the way. “Are you still itchy?” She checked the consistency of the slime running down her finger, growing colder and thicker as she played with it.
2e9c76f38906.t: Dengan ketawa nakal, Eori menggosok jarinya ke bawah dada dan perut Harry, mengutip lendir sepanjang jalan. “Kau masih gatal?” Dia memeriksa kepekatan lendir yang mengalir di jarinya, menjadi semakin sejuk dan pekat sementara dia bermain dengannya.

310c271bc06d.en: “Like—it lives on soil. It’s like a stringy thingy that wiggles around? No head or feet—I—used it to fish with? I-I think?” Harry kept looking down, speaking inwardly. “Did I ever fish?” slipped out at the end, sounding like a loud thought.
310c271bc06d.t: “Macam—ia hidup dalam tanah. Ia macam benda panjang berserat yang menggeliang-geliut? Tak ada kepala atau kaki—saya—guna untuk memancing? S-saya rasa?” Harry terus memandang ke bawah, bercakap perlahan. “Saya pernah memancing ke?” terlepas di hujungnya, kedengaran seperti fikiran yang kuat.

33b6f87c2199.en: “SAY IT!” Eori struck the journal on his head with a vertical swing but didn’t convert all the potential energy into kinetic—making a soft thud sound instead of a loud smack.
33b6f87c2199.t: “CAKAP!” Eori menghentak jurnal itu di kepalanya dengan hayunan menegak tetapi tidak menukarkan semua tenaga keupayaan kepada kinetik—menghasilkan bunyi gedebuk lembut dan bukannya tamparan kuat.

347b8aab4c54.en: Skin breathing? Eori paused; her ears didn’t believe what she had precisely heard. An annoyance within her began transforming into a scientific curiosity. She lowered her journal. “Explain yourself.”
347b8aab4c54.t: Bernafas melalui kulit? Eori terhenti; telinganya tidak percaya apa yang tepat didengarnya. Kejengkelan dalam dirinya mula berubah menjadi rasa ingin tahu saintifik. Dia menurunkan jurnalnya. “Terangkan.”

3957035a05d4.en: The inherited walking heart colors can’t be enough to interfere with it. Eori fed him another spoonful, this time containing a red-carapace worm because her hands could not hold back waiting for the complete Tier I transformation. “How about now?” She observed Harry grunting even more as his skin turned reddish brown, pouring thick sweat through every pore of his skin. She touched the sweat, feeling its sliminess similar to the consistency of a dog slobber. “Oh! It’s slimy already!”
3957035a05d4.t: Warna walking heart yang diwarisi tak mungkin cukup untuk mengganggunya. Eori menyuapnya sesudu lagi, kali ini mengandungi cacing berkarapas merah kerana tangannya tidak dapat menahan diri menunggu transformasi Tahap I yang lengkap. “Macam mana sekarang?” Dia memerhatikan Harry merengus lebih kuat sementara kulitnya bertukar menjadi coklat kemerahan, mencurahkan peluh pekat melalui setiap liang kulitnya. Dia menyentuh peluh itu, merasakan kelendirannya serupa dengan kepekatan air liur anjing. “Oh! Dah berlendir!”

4118996f4832.t: Eori mengeluh. “Senang je sial! Tekan lidah kau kat lelangit mulut, lepas tu gelongsor ke belakang. Sekarang tarik nafas melalui hidung!”

414b62b08c3c.en: Which direction should I research first? Eori looked at her notes, seeing several possible directions written down, then kept on looking around at the wall of macabre jars, seeing if anything else tickled her scientific curiosity. For cost reduction, barina lungs are already the cheapest amphibian lung I can get. Gills, too—which leaves a fungi replacement for lakata. Tyr is quite similar and would reduce the cost by a whole pearl per five nari gels—but I have no fucking idea how to counterbalance the hallucinations. Eori grabbed a jar off the wall and glanced at it closer. The brownish water revealed mushroom slices floating around alongside tiny golden-yellow globules resembling tapioca pearls. Tyr does not reduce heart rate—what if I try reducing or mixing ratios and check if that has a one-to-one relation with potencies? She placed the jar on the table.
414b62b08c3c.t: Arah mana yang aku patut kaji dulu? Eori memandang notanya, melihat beberapa kemungkinan arah yang ditulis, kemudian terus memandang sekeliling dinding balang mengerikan, melihat jika ada apa-apa lagi yang menggeletek rasa ingin tahu saintifiknya. Untuk kurangkan kos, paru-paru barina dah paru-paru amfibia paling murah yang aku boleh dapat. Insang pun sama—yang tinggal pengganti kulat untuk lakata. Tyr agak serupa dan akan kurangkan kos sebanyak satu pearl penuh setiap lima nari gel—tapi aku langsung tak tahu sial macam mana nak imbangkan halusinasi tu. Eori mengambil sebuah balang dari dinding dan melihatnya lebih dekat.
